entries.summary: Phase 2B through Phase 3A reusable handoff context linking skill contracts, verification gates, signed native snapshot policy, Phase 2A context-cache recovery, and Issue-backed work logs.

handoffNotes.summary: Use ai/agent-handoff.json and ai/skill-catalog.json when dispatching or reviewing Phase 2B skill/handoff reuse work.
Use ai/verification-gates.md, ai/verification-policy.json, and scripts/ai/verification-gate.sh for Phase 2C verification completeness and task/change applicability mapping.

Use ai/native-runtime-adapters.json, ai/native-runtime-adapters.md, and the native runtime snapshot schema for Phase 3A claimed/trusted status, ephemeral Ed25519 verification, signed task/event-set binding, and signed resolutionEventIds binding; runtime snapshots are not reusable cache evidence.

Verification-decision cache reuse requires the exact ordered required-plus-optional check set with check/producer-indexed leaf-result and schema-bound evidence digests, plus task, gate, commit, change type, entry point, policy, environment, and expiry identity; the current native result lacks a correlated durable envelope, so no canonical reusable PASS decision is materialized.
Use context-map schemaVersion 2 route phases and agent-handoff schemaVersion 2 context state to read late, opt into deferred scope narrowly, and block handoffs with missing required context.
